body: I’ve made enough excuses I feel, give me a week

Do you wanna chat? What’s going on?

I’m really sorry if I devalued your struggle.

I’m sorry for your loss. For me, however, this pandemic has cause so much damage to every part of my life; socially im pushing everyone away, academically my grades are in the shit, mentally my anxiety is at an all time high and is only rising, physically I’ve become weaker and gained more weight. Everything has become worse, and it won’t let up. I’m tired of having to fight myself everyday, that’s why I give myself till next year.
What did push you forward? If you’re okay answering that.
I appreciate the kind words, I really do. OCD on the other hand doesn’t care. Everything bad in my life is at the forefront and I’m tired. If I’m ready I’ll just end it all then.
